summary: DEMO ENTRY, NOT A REAL VULNERABILITY: example advisory for userspace-resource-manager
details: DEMO ENTRY, NOT A REAL VULNERABILITY. It only demonstrates how a vulnerability in a QLI overlay package of Debian forky, which the Debian security tracker doesn't cover, is recorded, reported by Grype for every binary of the source package, and suppressed by an OpenVEX statement (see vex/demo.openvex.json). Remove it once real advisories exist.
